assessments.reasoning: The PostgreSQL 17.0 CREATE TABLE reference makes INHERITS optional, identifies its arguments as parents, and describes both column inheritance at creation and a continuing parent-child relationship.

challenge.method: Check whether inheritance is a one-time copy or guarantees successful creation with conflicting parent definitions.
challenge.results: The relationship continues after creation. Incompatible same-name column types can prevent creation, and compatible declarations can merge. Both qualifications fit the claim.

limitations: Type conflicts, declaration merging, and subsequent schema propagation have additional rules.
